form.label: Audit Trail
form.description: Administrative enrollment, threshold, maintenance and lifecycle changes stored in the lsw_audit KV Store.

search.query: | inputlookup lsw_audit | addinfo | where (info_min_time=0 OR event_time_epoch>=info_min_time) AND (info_max_time=0 OR event_time_epoch<=info_max_time) | eval scope_ui=case(scope="add","enrollment",true(),coalesce(scope,"-")), action_ui=coalesce(operation,"-"), haystack=lower(coalesce(actor,"")." ".scope_ui." ".coalesce(operation,"")." ".coalesce(index,"")." ".coalesce(host,"")." ".coalesce(change_ref,"")." ".coalesce(details,"")) | where ($audit_scope|s$="*" OR scope_ui=$audit_scope|s$) | where ($audit_action|s$="*" OR action_ui=$audit_action|s$) | where len(trim($audit_text|s$))=0 OR like(haystack,"%".lower(trim($audit_text|s$))."%")

div.p: Who changed what, where and when. One audit document is written for each affected source.

search.query: | eval source=index."|".host | stats dc(source) AS value

| eval Time=strftime(event_time_epoch,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), User=coalesce(actor,"-"), Scope=case(scope_ui="manage","Management",scope_ui="bulk","Bulk Actions",scope_ui="enrollment","Enrollment",scope_ui="scheduler","Scheduler",true(),scope_ui), Action=case(operation="source_enrolled","SOURCE ENROLLED",operation="threshold_change","THRESHOLD",operation="maintenance_set","MAINTENANCE",operation="lifecycle_change","LIFECYCLE",operation="maintenance_expired","MAINTENANCE EXPIRED",true(),upper(operation)), Old_status=coalesce(old_status,"-"), New_status=coalesce(new_status,"-"), Old_threshold=if(isnull(old_threshold_seconds),"-",round(old_threshold_seconds/60,0)." min"), New_threshold=if(isnull(new_threshold_seconds),"-",round(new_threshold_seconds/60,0)." min"), Old_maintenance=case(isnull(old_maintenance_until),"-",old_maintenance_until=0,"-",true(),strftime(old_maintenance_until,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")), New_maintenance=case(isnull(new_maintenance_until),"-",new_maintenance_until=0,"-",true(),strftime(new_maintenance_until,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")), Origin=case( change_ref="ui-threshold","Management · threshold", change_ref="ui-maintenance","Management · maintenance", change_ref="ui-maintenance-clear","Management · maintenance cleared", change_ref="ui-activate","Management · activate", change_ref="ui-retire","Management · retire", change_ref="ui-discovery-enroll","Discover · enrollment", change_ref="setup-initial-enrollment","Initial Setup · enrollment", change_ref="setup-refresh","Initial Setup · refresh", change_ref="maintenance-expired","Scheduler · maintenance expiry", like(change_ref,"ui-bulk-%"),"Bulk Actions · ".replace(change_ref,"^ui-bulk-",""), true(),coalesce(change_ref,"-") ) | sort 0 - event_time_epoch | table Time User Scope Action index host Old_status New_status Old_threshold New_threshold Old_maintenance New_maintenance Origin details
